evidence_boundary: Static, source-bound reachability and campaign-coverage census only. This file contains no solver timing, common-unit conversion, ECDLP ratio, or leaderboard promotion.

historical_2026_10_31.comparison: The old counts are historical. The live executable has 37 more top-level methods and 10 more system solvers; its nested inventory also has 12 PDP3 and 4 PKM-tower engines.

factor_bases.closure_note: The pipeline lists are the accepted names in prime_base_for, binary_base_for, the linked ecbench plug-ins, and the specialized instance dispatches. Method-local builders are not interchangeable pipeline knobs. Source hashes are locked in SOURCE_SHA256SUMS.

decomposition_oracles.closure_note: Aliases are retained because they are accepted executable spellings. Native counters across these oracles are not one common unit.

technique_dispositions.f4: registered: f4-f2, matrix-f4, inherited-f4 variants, m4gb-f2 and m4gb-f2-server; current-source performance unmeasured
technique_dispositions.faugere_lachartre_f4: embedded in f4-f2 and related F4 kernels rather than a separate SystemSolver id; component coverage only until matched E2E execution
technique_dispositions.f5: registered: matrix-f5 and PKM sig-f5; solver-local native units cannot be cross-ranked with F4 without complete common pricing
technique_dispositions.f6: registered: PDP3 f6-ic and f6-ic-pair plus PKM f6; enclosing pipeline work remains mandatory
technique_dispositions.sat_cdcl: registered native system solver; current matched E2E execution missing
technique_dispositions.wdsat: historical external path, not a live SystemSolver; blocked from promotion by the retained 1-of-16 false-UNSAT result reproduced on two seeds
technique_dispositions.fes: registered scalar, GPU and wide FES plus two FES-then-* hybrids
technique_dispositions.gray_code: implemented inside scalar, GPU and wide FES; it is not a separately priced solver id
technique_dispositions.guess_and_determine: represented by crossbred-f2 and hybrid solver paths; no current common-priced E2E comparison
technique_dispositions.root_finding: 12 explicit root/table routes are listed above; the three batch/harvest PDP3 engines were live but absent from the pre-fix optimization inventory
technique_dispositions.external_controls: Magma, msolve, Singular, FGb, M4GB CLI, FLINT/NTL CLI, CryptoMiniSat, Kissat, CaDiCaL and WDSat were not found on PATH in this runtime

ranking_rule: System-solver native units, SAT conflicts, FES scalar/vector XORs, F4 word work, PKM multiply-adds, and root-table work are not cross-ranked. A rank needs complete common pricing or matched verified L2 end-to-end wall evidence with all phases and controls.
